visual_action: A montage of border security-related B-roll footage. It shows a helicopter in flight, two U.S. Border Patrol trucks in a desert area with a border wall in the background, and a close-up of a U.S. Border Patrol van. The video ends with black-and-white shots of the White House.

cast.name: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE)
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads: "Thanks! ICE is deporting all criminal illegal aliens"

cast.name: U.S. Customs and Border Protection
cast.evidence: The organization's name and its sub-agency "BORDER PATROL" are visible on vehicles shown in the video.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video ends with shots of the White House building, and the text "THE WHITE HOUSE" is displayed. The official White House logo is also present at the bottom of the screen in the initial clips.

on_screen_text.text: Thanks! ICE is deporting all criminal illegal aliens & there is no crisis at the border

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue, only music.
audio_music: An upbeat, energetic synth-pop track with a celebratory and triumphant feel plays throughout the video.
editing_pacing: The video is a short montage with quick cuts between different B-roll shots.
cultural_references: The 'You Look Happier' meme format, where a positive change is attributed to a specific cause.
central_claim: The administration has solved the crisis at the border by having ICE deport all criminal illegal aliens, resulting in a 'happier' state of affairs.
intended_effect: To make viewers feel proud of and confident in the administration's border security and immigration policies.
